# OECD country: oecd-country (OECD)

One OECD member: the latest leading indicator, unemployment, inflation and growth, and the members on a map shaded by inflation. One row per oecd country, keyed by COUNTRY_ID. Read by the **oecd** pack's connector `oecd-store` (table `<root>/oecd/oecd-country/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/oecd/samples/oecd-country.jsonl`, 10 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/oecd/samples/oecd-country.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `COUNTRY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 10 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
    {

      "LATEST": 99.9505,

      "OECD_SERIES": "OECDS-AUS-CLI",
      "PERIOD": "2026-09",
      "TITLE": "Composite leading indicator",
      "UNIT": "index, long-term average = 100"
    },
    {
      "CHANGE": 0.066741,
      "LATEST": 4.718349,
      "MEASURE": "UNEMPLOYMENT",

    "SOURCE": "OECD",
    "URL": "https://data-explorer.oecd.org/"
  },
  "UNEMPLOYMENT": 4.718349,

```

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `COUNTRY_ID` | string | required | OECD- and the member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. | pattern `^OECD-` | `"OECD-AUS"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The member's name as the OECD writes it. | — | `"Australia"` |
| `GDP_GROWTH` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Real GDP growth on the previous quarter, seasonally adjusted. | unit: % | `0.419502713` |
| `GDP_GROWTH_PERIOD` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | seen: `2026-Q3`, `2026-Q2` | `"2026-Q2"` |
| `INFLATION` | number | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | Consumer price inflation, all items, on the same month a year before. | unit: % a year | `4.34` |
| `INFLATION_PERIOD` | string | optional (filled in 90% of rows) | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | seen: `2026-09`, `2025-12`, `2024-07` | `"2026-09"` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (the OECD's REF_AREA), the key the map shades by. | — | `"AUS"` |
| `LEADING_INDICATOR` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The composite leading indicator, amplitude adjusted: above 100 and rising, growth above trend ahead. | unit: index, long-term average = 100 | `99.9505` |
| `LEADING_INDICATOR_PERIOD` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | — | `"2026-09"` |
| `MEASURES` | array of objects | required | Every measure the feed pulled for the member, one row each: MEASURE, TITLE, UNIT, LATEST, PERIOD, CHANGE and OECD_SERIES. | — | [4 objects] |
| `MEASURES[].CHANGE` | number | optional (filled in every `MEASURES[]` entry) | The latest value less the previous period's. | unit: the row's UNIT | `-0.04308` |
| `MEASURES[].LATEST` | number | required | The latest value. | unit: the row's UNIT | `99.9505` |
| `MEASURES[].MEASURE` | string | required | The measure's id in the feed's YAML (CLI, UNEMPLOYMENT, INFLATION, GDP_GROWTH). | seen: `CLI`, `GDP_GROWTH`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`, `INFLATION` | `"CLI"` |
| `MEASURES[].OECD_SERIES` | string | required | The oecd-series page with the history (OECDS-<ISO3>-<measure>). | pattern `^OECDS-`; links to `oecd-series` | `"OECDS-AUS-CLI"` |
| `MEASURES[].PERIOD` | string | required | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | seen: `2026-09`, `2026-Q3`, `2026-Q2`, `2025-12`, `2024-07`, `2026-07` | `"2026-09"` |
| `MEASURES[].TITLE` | string | required | The measure's title in the feed's YAML. | seen: `Composite leading indicator`, `Real GDP growth, quarter on quarter`, `Unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted`, `Consumer price inflation, year on year` | `"Composite leading indicator"` |
| `MEASURES[].UNIT` | string | required | What the measure is in. | seen: `%`, `% of labour force`, `index, long-term average = 100`, `% a year` | `"index, long-term average = 100"` |
| `MEASURE_COUNT` | integer | required | How many measures have a value for the member. | seen: `4`, `3` | `4` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The member's name as the OECD writes it. | — | `"Australia"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: OECD Data Explorer (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The OECD dataflow the record was built from. | — | `"OECD Data Explorer (SDMX)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"OECD terms and conditions: data may be extracted, copied a…` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | — | `"OECD"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The OECD Data Explorer's page for the dataflow. | — | `"https://data-explorer.oecd.org/"` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The harmonised unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted, ages 15 and over. | unit: % of labour force | `4.718349` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT_PERIOD` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | seen: `2026-09`, `2026-07` | `"2026-09"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 10 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `COUNTRY_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `COUNTRY_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `MEASURES`, `PROVENANCE`, `MEASURE_COUNT` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `COUNTRY_NAME`, `GDP_GROWTH`, `GDP_GROWTH_PERIOD`, `LEADING_INDICATOR`, `LEADING_INDICATOR_PERIOD`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`, `UNEMPLOYMENT_PERIOD`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `COUNTRY_ID` per snapshot.
- `COUNTRY_ID` matches `^OECD-`.
- `MEASURE_COUNT` is at least 0.
